title: Triads and inversions
status: First draft, written before you started Level 1. Before printing, re-tune it from your Level 2 check-in sheet and practice log: pairs, targets and tempos are best guesses.
summary: Three-note chords on the top strings: every major and minor triad in its three inversions on strings 1-2-3 (and the major ones on 2-3-4). Triads turn slash chords into something you can read, give you a second, higher voicing for every chord you know, and let a bass line move under a held chord. Street Spirit trains an even arpeggio over one-finger figure changes; While My Guitar Gently Weeps walks its bass down under Am and moves to A major for the bridge.
goals: Play any major or minor triad in all three inversions on strings 1-2-3, and major triads on 2-3-4, from the chord name.
Choose the nearest inversion for each chord of a progression, staying within five frets.
Street Spirit with the record at 138, the picking hand never stopping.
While My Guitar Gently Weeps with the record, the descending bass clean.
A natural minor (fret 5) and A minor pentatonic box 1 in eighths at 100; the seven triads of G up strings 1-2-3.

reading.note: week 2 — positions, pentatonic boxes, natural minor.

song_plan: Core: **Street Spirit** (Song day weeks 1–2) and **While My Guitar Gently Weeps** (weeks 3–4); Session D plays both. If top-string triads feel foreign in week 1, use *Here Comes My Baby* (the gentlest triad riff) for Session A's song block that week. Swap a core song for an alternate when you can already play it with the record, or when its hard change is still under 15 a minute after two weeks. Alternates, easiest first: *Here Comes My Baby* (top-string triads), *Fake Plastic Trees* (thumb-over Dmaj9/F♯), *Needle in the Hay* (F/C at 114).

exit_criteria: Benchmarks 1–6 at target in two Session Ds in a row.
Street Spirit with the record at 138, picking hand unbroken.
While My Guitar Gently Weeps with the record: the verse bass walk and the A-major bridge clean.
Any major or minor triad called from Level 2's chord-call list found on strings 1-2-3 in all three inversions within ten seconds.
A natural minor (fret 5) and A minor pentatonic box 1 in eighths at 100.
stuck: Not every box ticked after 6 weeks? Move on anyway. Keep one song from this level (a core song or an easier alternate) as a 5-minute play-through in Level 4's Session D, and open every Level 4 Session A primer with your weakest pair until it reaches target.
skip_ahead: Pass every benchmark cold (first attempt, no practice that day) in week 1's Session D? Go straight to Level 4.

drills.title: One-minute changes
drills.instructions: Timer at 1:00. One down-strum per chord, change, strum the other, as fast as you can while staying clean. Count clean landings only. Two rounds per pair; write the better count.

drills.title: Air shapes
drills.instructions: Hand off the neck. Form the whole shape an inch above the strings, land all fingers at once, strum, check every string, lift. Ten per shape.

drills.title: Place and lift
drills.instructions: Fret the shape, relax until the fingers just touch, press again. Twenty presses, one per click at 60, no strumming.

drills.title: Anchor hunt
drills.instructions: Before a new pair, say what stays (anchor), what slides along its string (guide) and what jumps. Then ten changes keeping anchors down. This level: G/D (7-8-7) ↔ C/E (9-8-8) = the string-2 note at fret 8 stays; the bass walk under Am = the Am fingers never move; triad climbs = the finger on string 1 guides.

drills.title: Change loop
drills.instructions: Strum chord 1 once, change, strum chord 2 once, stop, reset. Ten clean in a row; a miss sets the count back to zero.

drills.title: Tempo ladder
drills.instructions: One chord per bar, four down-strums (or the song's figure). Start where it is perfect (try 50). Three clean passes: +4 bpm. A miss: −8 bpm. Write the top clean tempo in today's blank.

drills.title: Eyes closed
drills.instructions: Make the change without looking; open your eyes after landing to check. Ten times.

drills.title: Song loop
drills.instructions: Loop the two bars around the hard change in the song's own rhythm, 10 bpm under this week's tempo. Then add a bar either side. Then the whole section.

drills.title: Random pairs
drills.instructions: Write the 14 chord names from the chord page on scraps. Draw two, do one-minute changes, write the pair and count on the back of the sheet. Draw again.

drills.title: Triad climb
drills.instructions: One triad per beat at 60, up and back, saying “first, second, root”. **G on 1-2-3:** G/B 4-3-3 → G/D 7-8-7 → G 12-12-10. **Gm:** 3-3-3 → 7-8-6 → 12-11-10. **G on 2-3-4:** G 5-4-3 → G/B 9-7-8 → G/D 12-12-12. Then move each climb: A (+2 frets), F (−2: F/A 2-1-1, F/C 5-6-5, F 10-10-8).

drills.title: Nearest inversion
drills.instructions: Strings 1-2-3 only, staying within frets 4–10. **G – Em – C – D:** G/D 7-8-7 → Em 9-8-7 → C/E 9-8-8 → D 7-7-5. **Am – F – C – G:** Am/C 5-5-5 → F/C 5-6-5 → C 5-5-3 → G/B 4-3-3. One per bar at 70, then two beats each. Listen to the top note move by step.

drills.title: Triads up the key
drills.instructions: G major, all in first inversion on strings 1-2-3: G/B 4-3-3 · Am 5-5-5 · Bm 7-7-7 · C 9-8-8 · D 11-10-10 · Em 12-12-12 · F♯° 14-13-14 · G 16-15-15. One per beat, saying I ii iii IV V vi vii° I. (The middle four are the Reckoner riff.)

drills.title: Walking bass under a held chord
drills.instructions: Hold the top of Am (x02210) and walk the bass: Am → Am/G♯ 4x2210 → Am/G 3x2210 → Am/F♯ 2x2210 (thumb) → Fmaj7 xx3210. One per bar at 60, then two beats each. Then D xx0232 with the bass walking D – C♯ – B – A on string 5 (open D, x4, x2, x0).

drills.title: Name the triad's notes
drills.instructions: For each triad in this week's pairs: pick each string alone and say its job and name (“G/B: B is the 3rd, D the 5th, G the root”). Then say the inversion: lowest note root = root position, 3rd = first, 5th = second.

drills.title: Scale in 3rds
drills.instructions: In this week's position play pairs a 3rd apart (1–3, 2–4, 3–5 …) to the top and back down. Quarters at 60 until clean, then eighths.

drills.title: Make something
drills.instructions: Key of Am or G. Four chords, played only as triads on strings 1-2-3 within five frets (nearest inversion), plus one bar where the bass walks under a held chord. Loop; each pass change one thing. Write the keeper (chords and frets) in Notes.

sessions.name: A
sessions.title: Chord day
sessions.focus: New shapes and this week's three pairs (week plan, column 1). Pair 1 is the hard one.

blocks.title: Primer: today's shapes
blocks.instructions: Triad climb in G and Gm at 60 (2 min). Then air shapes ×10 on both chords of pair 1. Carried a weak pair from Level 2? Change-loop it for the last minute.

blocks.title: Pair 1: the full recipe
blocks.instructions: Anchor hunt (say what stays, slides, jumps) → slow motion ×5 → change loop to 10 clean → tempo ladder from 50, one chord per bar. A chain of chords? Ladder the whole chain. Stop at the clock.

blocks.title: Pairs 2 and 3
blocks.instructions: Change loop to 10 clean on each, then one-minute changes: two rounds each. Write the better count.

blocks.title: Nearest inversion
blocks.instructions: G – Em – C – D, then Am – F – C – G, all on strings 1-2-3 between frets 4 and 10 (frets on the drill page). One per bar.

blocks.title: Fretboard: name the notes
blocks.instructions: For each triad in this week's pairs, pick each string and say its note and job (root, 3rd, 5th), then the inversion.

blocks.title: Song: put pair 1 back in
blocks.instructions: In this week's song section: song loop on the two bars with pair 1, then the section ×2 at this week's tempo.

blocks.title: Log
blocks.instructions: Log page: tick A, write the minutes. In Notes: the change that felt worst today.

sessions.name: B
sessions.title: Fretboard day
sessions.focus: Scales as the source of the chords: positions, 3rds, and the triads of a key (week plan, column 2).

blocks.title: Primer
blocks.instructions: Air shapes ×10 on the two chords of pair 1, then the change with eyes closed ×10.

blocks.title: Triads on the map
blocks.instructions: On the G major whole-neck diagram, find every G, B and D on strings 1–3 from fret 3 to 15. Each group of three neighbouring notes is a G triad: play and name its inversion.

blocks.title: This week's scale
blocks.instructions: Week 1 box 1; weeks 2 and 4 A natural minor at fret 5 (week 2 in 3rds); week 3 the triads of G. Say the root at every square. Quarters at 60, then eighths on the tempo ladder.

blocks.title: Triads up the key
blocks.instructions: G/B 4-3-3 up to G 16-15-15, one per beat, saying the numbers. Then I–vi–IV–V (G Em C D) using only these shapes, then with the nearest inversions instead.

blocks.title: Song by numbers: While My Guitar Gently Weeps
blocks.instructions: Verse a in Am: i, i/♭7, i/6, ♭VImaj7, i, ♭VII, IV, V (Am Am/G Am/F♯ Fmaj7 Am G D E). Play it ×4 at this week's WMGGW tempo saying the numbers, then verse b, where ♭III (C) replaces IV (D).

blocks.title: Log
blocks.instructions: Log page: tick B, write the minutes. Notes: what on the fretboard is still slow.

sessions.name: C
sessions.title: Song day
sessions.focus: Longest song block: isolate this week's hard change (pair 1), then play the section and the song in time. Weeks 1–2 Street Spirit, weeks 3–4 While My Guitar Gently Weeps.

blocks.title: Primer
blocks.instructions: Place-and-lift ×20 and air shapes ×10 on the two chords of pair 1. Street Spirit weeks: 2 minutes of the picking pattern on Am alone, metronome at this week's tempo.

blocks.title: The hard change
blocks.instructions: Change loop to 10 clean, then tempo ladder one chord per bar from 50.

blocks.title: Fretboard: the bass line
blocks.instructions: Read this week's section. Play only the lowest note of every chord, in time, one per bar, naming it — that is the bass line you are holding up.

blocks.title: This week's song
blocks.instructions: Song loop round the hard change (5 min). The week's section ×3 at this week's tempo. Then the whole form without stopping — fumble through. Weeks 3–4: the last 5 minutes with the record.

blocks.title: The other core song
blocks.instructions: Once through at this week's tempo for it. Mark any bar that broke and give it one song loop.

blocks.title: Log
blocks.instructions: Log page: tick C, write the minutes. Notes: the bar where you stopped, if any.

sessions.name: D
sessions.title: Mix and measure
sessions.focus: Short versions of everything, the benchmarks with numbers, one review from Level 2, and five minutes of your own music.

blocks.title: Primer
blocks.instructions: Air shapes ×5 on every chord in benchmarks 2–4. The tests are taken cold.

blocks.title: Benchmarks
blocks.instructions: One-minute changes, one round each: **2** G/D 7-8-7 ↔ C/E 9-8-8 · **3** Am/F♯ ↔ Fmaj7 · **4** C♯m ↔ F♯m. Tempo ladder from 60 for **1** the G triad climb, **5** triads up the key and **6** A natural minor in eighths. Write all six numbers in the log.

blocks.title: Review from Level 2
blocks.instructions: One-minute changes on Bm (A2) ↔ F♯m (E2) and Gm7 (E3) ↔ C7 (A3) — or the pair you carried from Level 2. Then five chords from the chord-call list.

blocks.title: Songs, measured
blocks.instructions: Street Spirit, then While My Guitar Gently Weeps — with the record from week 3, at this week's tempo before that. Write benchmarks 7 and 8 in the log.

blocks.title: Make something
blocks.instructions: Am or G: four chords as 1-2-3 triads within five frets, plus one bass walk under a held chord. Loop, change one thing per pass, write the keeper in Notes.

blocks.title: Log and exit check
blocks.instructions: Tick D in the log. Tick any exit box you passed today. Week 6 or all boxes ticked? Fill in the check-in sheet.
